demos.name: AI Guard Demo
demos.description: AI Guard end to end: an agent gateway, Agentic Apps (MCP doors) and an Agent Registry of mock keys with per-key guardrails. Try a call as a key: identity, grant, tool filter, then the stand-in sidecar's verdict. Contract unverified; offline.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (port 7900; npm run doctor checks it). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:7900 only; the standalone sidecar on 7902 is host-run only and not in the image; HOST_PORT changes the published port, and the shelf's Start button does not set HOST_PORT). Edit composeFile to this checkout's absolute path.
